dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Istražite redoslijed uboda, boje konca, preskoke, podrezivanja i naredbe stroja prije proizvodnje. Pregledajte dizajn ubod po ubod, mijenjajte stilove prikaza i izvezite ono što vidite.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Interaktivna simulacija veza, pregled i izvoz.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Držite ravnalo uz ekran i povucite klizač dok traka ispod ne bude točno 100 mm duga, zatim pritisnite OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Kopiraj sliku u punoj rezoluciji u međuspremnik

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Jezik je postavljen na {language}. Ponovno pokreni InkSim sada da se primijeni?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Koristit će se zadani jezik sustava. Ponovno pokreni InkSim sada da se primijeni?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Svi otvoreni InkSim prozori bit će zatvoreni, a trenutna datoteka ponovno otvorena.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_failed.translation: Izvoz CSV-a iz Ink/Stitcha nije uspio.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Pogledaj output.err za pojedinosti o pogrešci.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Isteklo je vrijeme čekanja za pregled uboda.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Otvori ovaj SVG u novom prozoru Inkscapea.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: U ovoj mapi nema podržanih datoteka.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Dvaput klikni mapu da pregledaš njezine datoteke.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Dvaput klikni mapu da pregledaš njezine datoteke.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Za uređivanje SVG datoteka potreban je Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Potrebna je konfigurirana instalacija Ink/Stitcha i pokretač za Python.

dialog.open_browser.not_embroidery.translation: Ovo nije valjana datoteka za vez

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Generiraj podatke o ubodima iz ovog SVG-a pomoću Inkscapea/Ink/Stitcha.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Nije moguće pokrenuti aktivnu skriptu Ink/Stitcha ni konfigurirani pokretač Pythona.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Proširenje Ink/Stitch: provjera nije uspjela. Pokušaj ponovno putem Alati...

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Proširenje Ink/Stitch: nije pronađeno u mapama proširenja Inkscapea.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Proširenje Ink/Stitch: provjera nije moguća dok se ne konfigurira Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Proširenje Ink/Stitch: još nije provjereno. Provjeri putem Alati...

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: SVG izvor. Za pregled šavova potreban je Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: SVG izvor. Odaberi Pregled za generiranje podataka o šavovima pomoću Inkscapea/Ink/Stitcha.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Ovaj je SVG prevelik za pregled.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Nije moguće stvoriti privremenu datoteku za pregled: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Ova vrsta datoteke ne može se otvoriti u InkSimu.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Nije moguće spremiti stanje proširenja Inkscapea: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Nije moguće pregledati mape proširenja Inkscapea: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Nije moguće instalirati proširenja InkSima za Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Proširenja InkSima za Inkscape instalirana su ili ažurirana u {path}. Ponovno pokreni Inkscape da bi ih učitao.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape nije pronađen na putanji sustava.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Nije moguće pročitati mape proširenja Inkscapea: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Ponovno pokreni Inkscape da bi se primijenio novi Python interpreter.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Nije moguće ukloniti staru mapu proširenja InkSima: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Stare mape proširenja InkSima uklonjene su. Ponovno pokreni Inkscape da osvježiš popis proširenja.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Otkrivena konfiguracija spremljena je u postavke InkSima.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Nije moguće pregledati mape proširenja Inkscapea: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Potreban pokretač '{command}' nije pronađen; postavka nije promijenjena.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape nije pronađen. Odaberi njegovu izvršnu datoteku da provjeriš postavke.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Nije moguće provjeriti ni ažurirati Python interpreter: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Postavka Python interpretera nije provjerena jer korisnička mapa proširenja nije dostupna.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Ponovno pokreni Inkscape da bi se primijenio ažurirani interpreter.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Inkscape nije odgovorio u roku od {seconds} sekundi.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Odaberi izvršnu datoteku Inkscapea za provjeru.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape nije odgovorio u roku od {seconds} sekundi. Druga instanca Inkscapea ili proširenje možda blokira komunikaciju. Zatvori druge instance Inkscapea ili onemogući proširenje koje blokira komunikaciju pa pokušaj ponovno.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Potreban pokretač '{command}' nije pronađen. Samostalno instaliraj alat uvr naredbom `uv tool install uvr`, a zatim ponovno pokreni ovu konfiguraciju. InkSim ga neće instalirati.

menu.file.quit_all.translation: Izađi iz svih prozora i poslužitelja

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Nema učitane datoteke veza za izvoz.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Resetiraj širinu linije i faktore sjenčanja

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Kliknite za podešavanje faktora tame, faktora svjetla i širine linije

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Pogled odozdo (crtaj kasnije ubode ispod ranijih)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Promijeni prikaz preskoka: isključeno, sve, samo rizično
